rules.statement: A party who holds legal title to property as a security for a debt is deemed to hold the legal title as a constructive trustee for the benefit of the transferor, subject to the discharge of the underlying financial obligation.
rules.supporting_quote: Where it is established that the transfer was intended as security for a loan, the transferee is deemed to hold the legal title as a constructive trustee for the benefit of the transferor, subject to the discharge of the underlying financial obligation.
